prompt.generated_prompt_string: A clearly adult woman with long wavy ginger-red hair, pale complexion, minimal natural makeup, calm confident expression, slightly lifted chin, and direct gaze leans back against a brushed stainless-steel elevator panel. She wears a cropped ringer T-shirt with white body and bright mustard-yellow short sleeves and neckline trim, bold lowercase born to be fast text, three mustard stars, and a simple fictional lightning-bolt graphic. Pair it with mustard-yellow denim jeans or shorts with button fly and visible stitching, plus a small black quilted shoulder bag with silver chain strap over the right shoulder. Her right arm hangs naturally and her left hand rests in the front pocket. Use a light-gray wall on the right, small dark control panel, direct on-camera flash at approximately 5000K, hard drop shadow, eye-level medium framing from mid-thigh up, 35mm lens, realistic metal reflections, film grain, and candid Y2K snapshot styling. Keep the pose confident and non-sexual; use fictional graphic text and no real logos.
